title: 春日忆李白
titleEn: Thinking of Li Bai on a Spring Day
author: 杜甫
intro: One great poet writing about another: Du Fu praises Li Bai’s genius, then pictures the two of them under different skies, wishing they could share a cup of wine and talk about poetry again.
analysis: 杜甫和李白是唐代最有名的两位诗人，两人曾一起游玩，结下深厚友谊，分别后杜甫写过很多首怀念李白的诗，这是其中最有名的一首。前四句夸李白的诗：天下无敌，想法超出常人，像南北朝的庾信一样清新，像鲍照一样俊逸——用前代名家作比，评价非常高。五六句是全诗最动人的地方：“渭北春天树，江东日暮云”，杜甫在渭水北边看春天的树，李白在江东望傍晚的云，一句写自己，一句写对方，没有一个“想”字，两地相思却都在景物里。后人把“春树暮云”当作怀念朋友的固定说法。最后两句盼望再见：什么时候能一起喝一杯酒，再细细地谈论文章？以诗开头，以论诗结尾，可见两人是真正的知音。
analysisEn: Du Fu and Li Bai are the two most famous poets of the Tang dynasty. They met in 744, travelled together for a while and became close friends; after they parted, Du Fu wrote many poems missing Li Bai, and this is the best loved. The first four lines praise Li Bai’s poetry: no one can match it, his thoughts soar above the crowd, he is as fresh as Yu Xin and as elegant as Bao Zhao — two admired poets of earlier centuries. Comparing a living friend to old masters is very high praise. Lines five and six are the heart of the poem: “trees in spring north of the Wei, clouds at dusk east of the river.” One line is where Du Fu stands, the other is where Li Bai is; the word “miss” never appears, yet the longing sits in the landscape. Later writers turned “spring trees, evening clouds” (春树暮云) into a set phrase for thinking of a distant friend. The ending asks when they can share a cup of wine and talk about writing again, line by line. The poem begins and ends with poetry — the sign of two people who truly understood each other.
background: Du Fu (712–770), honoured as the “Sage of Poetry”, lived through the An Lushan Rebellion and wrote movingly about ordinary people’s suffering. He wrote this around 746–747 in Chang’an, a year or two after parting from Li Bai, who was then wandering in the lower Yangtze region (Jiangdong).
pronunciation: 庾 yǔ（姓）；参军 cān jūn（官名，不读 shēn）；樽 zūn；重与 chóng yǔ（“再次”，不读 zhòng）。
version: 采用通行文本。“一樽酒”的“樽”，《李太白集注》等本作“尊”（同义异体）。庾开府指北周庾信，曾任开府仪同三司；鲍参军指南朝宋鲍照，曾任参军。

lines.lit: As for Li Bai, his poetry has no rival;
lines.en: Li Bai — no one writes poems like yours,

lines.lit: free and floating, his thoughts stand apart from the crowd.
lines.en: your thoughts drift high above the crowd.

lines.lit: Fresh and clear like Yu, the Kaifu official;
lines.en: Fresh as the verses of Yu Xin,

lines.lit: elegant and free like Bao, the adjutant.
lines.en: graceful as the lines of Bao Zhao.

lines.lit: North of the Wei River, trees in spring;
lines.en: Here north of the Wei, spring trees;

lines.lit: east of the Yangtze, clouds at sunset.
lines.en: there east of the river, evening clouds.

lines.lit: When, over a cup of wine,
lines.en: When will we sit with a cup of wine

lines.lit: will I again discuss writing with you in detail?
lines.en: and talk over poems, slowly, once more?

words.note: 古汉语语气词，和现代汉语“也是”的“也”不同。
现代汉语仍用，如“天下无敌”。
现代汉语说“超群”“与众不同”。

words.en: Yu Xin (513–581), a poet who held the title Kaifu
words.note: 用官名称呼人，是古代的尊称方式。

words.en: Bao Zhao (c. 414–466), a poet who served as an adjutant
north of the Wei River (near Chang’an)
east of the Yangtze, the lower Yangtze region

现代汉语“重新”“重来”的“重”。
古义是“谈论文章”，今天“论文”指学术文章。

imagery.name: 云
imagery.zh: 日暮的云是李白那边的景色：游子漂泊，像云一样没有定处。
imagery.en: The evening clouds are Li Bai’s sky — a wanderer drifting like a cloud with no fixed home.

imagery.name: 酒
imagery.zh: 一樽酒代表重逢：两位诗人边喝边谈诗，是杜甫最大的心愿。
imagery.en: A cup of wine stands for reunion: drinking and talking poetry together is all Du Fu wishes for.
